text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm meeting with Seiun Sky today to
prepare for
tomorrow's scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Once I round the corner, I'll act like I've
lost my
footing. Then at the end, I'll lose
on purpose and
make them
underestimate me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, the simulation went perfect.
They're gonna
fall right into my trap. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know it. ...All right, now I that I've
got my
plan all worked out, it's time for
some shut-eye.
choice_data_list: 本番で勝つための準備、だな

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The senior trainer of our opponent in the

scrimmage opens the door.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm just dropping by to discuss
tomorrow's race,
but what was that I
heard about "shut-eye"?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Shut-eye? That's ridiculous!
Hahaha... You
must have misheard.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Geez... That poor attitude of yours just
goes to
show how lousy a job your
trainer's doing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey now. My trainer never listens
no
matter how much I talk about
skipping practice—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Get them to underestimate us—if that's
her goal,
then I'm on board... I look at
her, hoping she gets
the message.
choice_data_list: すみません、俺の力不足で
すみません、私の力不足で

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, okay? You've clearly got no
idea what
it takes to be a trainer. And
your racer's a running
disaster.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I hope you both take a good look at
yourselves
after the race tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, the trainer leaves.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Yup.
choice_data_list: 俺も『油断』に協力できたかな？
私も『油断』に協力できたかな？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Seiun Sky arrives at the
track for
the scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep ya!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I want to look like I'm taking this
seriously. I
have to go all in to make my
strategy work!
choice_data_list: 勝負服で来たのか！？
勝負服で来たの！？

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Plus... this is how I get in the zone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oop, gotta go.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, you ready? It's race time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both racers step into their gates... and
they're off!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like she planned, Sky pretends she's
losing
her balance as she hits the turn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now all she has to do is tear ahead in a
straight
line, then lose in the end so the
other racer
underestimates her. But
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sky pulls ahead of the other racer and
seizes a
stunning victory!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Phew, I'm beat. That sure was a close one.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Things got real touch-and-go there. Gotta work on my cornering. I wasn't ready for that to mess me up again.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well I'll say, we really got whooped
there. Maybe
you two aren't entirely
hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But don't go thinking things'll turn out
this way
when we race for real. Heh, we
got some juicy
tidbits outta this... Well,
see ya.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh... Juicy tidbits, huh? Good
for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
They really had me sweating today. But I
got the
win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well... yeah.

text_block_list.text: Guess I couldn't help myself. Teehee! ☆

answer. I can't
help but wonder why she

"Nice job! Go take the rest of the day

text_block_list.text:
Trying to get a grip on Seiun Sky is like
grasping
at a cloud, but even so, I feel
like I've come to
understand her a little
more.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Bwuh? Don't tell me that race got you
all fired
up?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Geeez. Come on, Trainer...

Well, I guess we can do something for

I look to the sky and make my vow once
more. I'll
help Seiun Sky speed right
through the Twinkle

to victory!
